場合があります。皮膚に異常を感じたときは、すみやかにご使用をおやめください。 ●耳の近くで使用してはいけません。 誤って使用すると、聴覚を
損なう恐れがあります。●本商品には電子部品を使用しております。ペースメーカーをご使用の方は、本商品を身体に近づけないようご注意ください。
●LEDの光の点滅を見続けないでください。 気分が悪くなったりする恐れがあります。 ●電池(別売り)、電池ぶたなどの誤飲事故に注意して
ください。《電池を誤使用すると発熱・ 破裂 液漏れの恐れがあります。 下記に注意してください》 二次電池 (充電式電池) は、 絶対に使用しない

blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children under the indicated age.
• This product contains small parts. Take care that small children do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking.
• Wearing the belt for long periods may cause rashes or itching from sweat. Stop using it immediately if you notice any skin abnormality.
• Do not use this product near the ears. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, keep this product away from your body.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED lights. Doing so may make you feel unwell.
• Be careful of accidental swallowing of batteries (sold separately), battery covers, etc. Improper use of batteries may cause overheating, rupture, or leakage—see the precautions below.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with the correct + and − (polarity).
• After playing, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous. Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or dispose of batteries in fire.
• If battery electrolyte gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a physician. If it gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of the product or batteries, follow your local municipality's waste-disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
• Precautions for use: This product is made with precision. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains delicate electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it where it gets very hot or very cold.
• Dispose of plastic packaging materials immediately after opening.
• This product has painted parts. When storing it, keep it from touching other items (plastic goods, furniture, sofas), because the color may transfer.
• Do not strongly pull or bend movable or attached parts in directions they are not meant to move.
• Some voice lines may have different intonation or may be hard to hear due to the product’s characteristics.
• Do not insert anything other than compatible items into the Dynobress -MEMORIAL EDITION-. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.
